properties.assumptions: Definitions and admitted counterstates; neither zero mass nor statistical review proves malice.
properties.boundaries: Core plus separate review layer; statistical review queues are not semantic ledger judgments.
properties.statement: Provenance, operational treatment, numerical weight and attributed semantic state remain distinct.

properties.assumptions: Trusted keys/roots; collision/second-preimage resistance and signature unforgeability; fixed encoders, stable bytes and faithful verifier execution.
properties.boundaries: Only required representations. An optional missing product payload remains structurally represented with availability annotations.
properties.statement: Required committed modifications are detectable relative to authenticated expected roots.

properties.assumptions: Nonempty externally supplied receipt set, correct context/enrollment and expected authority; exactly reconstructed inventory/intake for full binding.
properties.boundaries: Intake-only coverage is narrower than admission verification. No independent registration deadline, delivery or universal set of attempted submissions.
properties.statement: Every presented authenticated receipt claim has one consistent inventory entry; full round binding also accounts for final dispositions.

properties.assumptions: Named enumeration/transformation profile, fixed committed source files and replay; path/position/content identities remain distinct for equal values.
properties.boundaries: Relative to supplied I0; historical pre-transform existence and pre-capture completeness are not independently timestamped.
properties.statement: Each enumerated committed record occurrence has a reproduced derivation or motivated exclusion, including many-to-one outputs.

properties.assumptions: Successful mass/quorum domain, authenticated inputs, preserved implementation/environment/order; n is the bound declared count, not proof of semantic data truth.
properties.boundaries: The original gated-composite live FedAvg profile. Graph-only checks and newer empirical adapters do not automatically satisfy this full antecedent.
properties.statement: Reconstructed policy, masses, rational coefficients, ordered operational weights and checkpoint bytes agree under the declared backend.

properties.assumptions: Gated-composite veto branch, nonnegative count, positive total mass and quorum for alpha. Distinguish observed and experimentally injected effective gates.
properties.boundaries: Observed gate failure excludes from ordinary scoring. Controlled M6 effective veto can be injected after the observed scoring population was formed.
properties.statement: Effective mandatory veto forces zero factor/mass; normalized alpha is zero when a valid aggregate exists.

properties.assumptions: Two valid normalizations for Delta; zero-padding on fixed K; not_submitted action padding. Frozen mass formula requires beta<1 and survivor quorum.
properties.boundaries: Delta_K>=2 beta; frozen Delta_K=2 beta. Every nonempty allowed removal gives J_K=1 under this explicit absence convention.
properties.statement: Original fixed-K L1 Delta and binary J remain distinct from survivor/rescoring diagnostics.

properties.assumptions: Validated normalized coefficient vectors and matching survivor population; comparable models with representable intermediate arithmetic. Caller binds model/weight/source correspondence.
properties.boundaries: TV is zero iff the two normalized coefficient vectors agree. Model L2 scalars do not add; zero TV need not mean unchanged raw scores.
properties.statement: Survivor policy TV and vector/model differences measure separate effects.

properties.assumptions: Authorized keys, fixed historical subject, application append/lock semantics and independently retained expected head for rollback/fork protection.
properties.boundaries: An old head authenticates its prefix, not a unique future suffix. No physical write prevention, trusted review time or truth of a semantic label.
properties.statement: Appending attributed review preserves historical decisions/coefficients/checkpoints and authenticates anchored prefixes.

properties.assumptions: Validated finite supplied DAG, known unique origins, three runtime edge types and authenticated round/product manifests; trusted expected graph snapshot.
properties.boundaries: Submission-occurrence v2 separates repeated bytes across contexts/client slots. Old snapshots retain their original release. Review is separate; radius is structural exposure, not damage, semantic guilt or all products ever created.
properties.statement: Typed BFS returns precisely supplied-graph descendants, shortest witnesses per exact edge-type set, and deduplicated selected-set union.

properties.assumptions: Full inputs for exactly all graph rounds; matching pinned authorities/sources/intervention population; retained review tip when review evidence is supplied.
properties.boundaries: No new Quote, successor training, trusted deadline, global product inventory or product-payload recomputation follows from composition.
properties.statement: Full source admission, graph, exact removal set and optional externally anchored attributed reviews can be verified together.

properties.assumptions: Fixed intervention, data/attacker schedule, seed/optimizer/environment/backend and starting checkpoint; preserve source releases and branch order.
properties.boundaries: Standalone round-local counterfactual preserves historical_policy_decisions_revalidated=false. The latest case-specific software verifiers cover their explicit transforms, not a generic live TPM replay.
properties.statement: A declared successor counterfactual requires fresh training from each changed base, or an independent equality certificate.

properties.assumptions: Authenticated payloads and independently checked participation, initial/warm checkpoint, local input commitments, seeds, optimizer and environment.
properties.boundaries: The API compares a projection of committed histories; it explicitly does not authenticate payloads or independently verify seeds/optimizer. Case verifiers must supply these antecedents.
properties.statement: Matched clean-reference reconstruction requires complete declared execution equality, not ASR zero alone.

properties.assumptions: Fixed calibrated cohort/views/thresholds, valid inputs, strict predecessor/round bindings and faithful state execution. Caller handles the proposal and quorum.
properties.boundaries: These are proposals, not the original full live-admission proof. Unsupported inputs may retain eligible proposed mass; no guaranteed eventual quarantine or classification accuracy.
properties.statement: Current/evidence-envelope actions are deterministic functions of their validated input prefix; mandatory veto remains non-compensable.

properties.assumptions: Externally justified clean references, separate cohort/fit/calibration/evaluation, frozen rules, authenticated observations and post-selection labelled controls.
properties.boundaries: V2 misses a member in every priority group of the added six cases; an accurate envelope prefix set is not a pairwise proof of collusion.
properties.statement: Clean-calibrated pair groups and individual anomaly sets remain retrospective hypotheses with measured errors.

properties.claim: Finite deterministic convex combination of clipped deltas; alpha and beta remain distinct.
properties.boundaries: Fixed base/limits/admitted masses, representable finite arithmetic, declared smoothing/iteration cap and export. Frozen-final-beta removal bound requires survivor quorum; no dynamic reweighting/ASR theorem.

properties.claim: Actual runtime matches the separately named robust transformation and binds original bundles, derived report and graph.
properties.boundaries: Full receipt/admission/Quote reconstruction, named opt-in profile, bounds/reference identity, original signed inputs and measured release. Software TPMs on one host; no external time/delivery guarantee.

properties.claim: Separately clean-calibrated pair/triple investigation hypotheses with measured false/missed members.
properties.boundaries: Fixed observable inputs, disjoint fit/calibration/evaluation roles. No universal recovery, intent, significance or automatic-exclusion guarantee.

incremental_review: Only two new numerical/selection modules and three profile-routing/schema modules differ from the preceding 119-module source. Reviewed finite reweighting, distinct input/final coefficients, opt-in profile selection, reference/mode validation, actual backend/report agreement, graph binding and historical-label preservation. Earlier AST differences from the 114-file matrix belong to the separately documented envelope/bounded integrations; they are flagged rather than declared identical.
proof_scope: Manual conditional arguments; source/AST binding is not proof of transitive equivalence or independent verification. Original FedAvg proof remains scoped to untransformed FedAvg. Bounded and robust transformations have explicit separate convexity/frozen-weight arguments and runtime replay evidence.
